feeds.title: Kerri's Crochet
feeds.description: Welcome to Kerri's Crochet where I'll be providing you with how-to videos and patterns for crochet appliqués that I have designed. I'll be making patterns and tutorials for the beginners right through to advanced crocheters. I hope you find my work informative and useful and check back regularly for updates and new designs and videos.

feeds.title: Threadbare Creations
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Rose! A quilt designer/crocheter/all round maker who loves creating beautiful things for my home and my family. My blog is where I share my quilt designs, recipes, tutorials and free patterns.

feeds.title: Homelea Lass Blog
feeds.description: Homelea Lass is a crocheting blog and a boutique that is centered on my desire to wrap women in love and help them to create a happy life through my chunky, artisan blankets and my wise words.

feeds.title: CraftyRie
feeds.description: A happy mix of craft, creation, and chaos! Crochet, Knitting, Sewing, Quilting, Baking, Cooking, Parenting, Gardening, and Tasmania.

feeds.title: Yarn Me Calm Blog
feeds.description: The calming yarn blog features articles related to crochet, knitting, crafts and more. Yarn Me Calm was started by the author Andrea Clements out of her love for knitting and crocheting to provide yarn products and a service to the people.

feeds.title: Auburncraft Crochet Design Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find articles about recently released crochet patterns.Crochet stories, ramblings, satire and ton of other things crochet related and maybe a few that are not!

feeds.title: Crochet between worlds
feeds.description: Hi there! We are Michelle and Anne and we share this blog! We have been friends for ages even though we live on different sides of the world. We share a common passion which is crochet but we blog about Australia, Germany, the Netherlands, food and other stuff we like too.

feeds.title: Lupey Loops
feeds.description: When chronic illness forces me to stop, crochet comes to the rescue...and I find my calling.

feeds.title: Hello Yellow Yarn
feeds.description: Hello! I'm MJ. Mum and crocheter behind Hello Yellow Yarn. Welcome to my craft corner! I love designing adorable amigurumi most of which are inspired by my children's fun and creative personalities!

feeds.title: little woollie
feeds.description: I have a love for crafty things, crochet, knitting and yarny makes, in particular, so you will be seeing a lot of my crafty adventures on this blog! A local wool shop filled with quality natural fibers and colorful yarns including wool, alpaca, cotton, and bamboo, with a mix of gorgeous brands and indie dyers. Blog by Julie Harrison.

feeds.title: Red Haired Amazona
feeds.description: A lazy domestic goddess and crochet queen doing stuff, digging stuff, buying other stuff, and occasionally remembering to parent her kids.

feeds.title: Hopeful Honey
feeds.description: Hello friends, I blog over at Hopeful Honey where you will find purely original crochet pattern designed with love!
